entries.note: The sending post accepted the item; the scan names its country.
Dispatched toward its destination from the sending country.
Sent abroad to the destination country.
Ecuador's office of exchange in Quito received the item from abroad and began processing it.

entries.wording: Proceso de revisión aduana - importación - Otro
entries.note: Customs inspection of the import. The last part names the kind of check; the map reads every kind as customs.

entries.wording: Despachado a oficina Centro Clasificación Quito
entries.note: Dispatched to the office the wording names, here Quito's sorting centre; the scan's place is the office it left. The map reads every office alike, and the wording without one.
An office, named as the scan's place, received the item.
The delivering agency received the item.
Delivered. The tracker follows it with who took the item and their cédula, which the adapter drops and the map ignores.
